name: Animated Shield
summary: A Shield that animates to hover and protect you, leaving your hands free.

stats.effect: While holding this {ref:equipment/shield}, you can take a {ref:glossary/bonus-action} to cause it to animate. The {ref:equipment/shield} leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The {ref:equipment/shield} remains animate for 1 minute, until you take a Bonus Action to end this effect, or until you die or have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition, at which point the {ref:equipment/shield} falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free.
